feedback_to_push_and_reflection.not_applicable_reason: Legacy multi-owner feedback fan-out was retired by COG-038; canonical attribution and proposal receipts are audited by the feedback attribution gate.

predictive_push_to_penalty.not_applicable_reason: Direct reaction-to-penalty reinforcement was retired by COG-038; reactions now create canonical attribution and proposal-only target receipts.

module_toggle_to_activation_contract.not_applicable_reason: Static activation registry validated by contract gates; it does not emit runtime business events.

toggle_output_to_consumer_effect.not_applicable_reason: Static output wiring registry validated by contract gates; runtime effects are covered by their business flow ids.

golden_benchmark_to_scorecard.not_applicable_reason: Deterministic synthetic release gate writes its own scorecard and does not represent a production business event stream.

wiki_quality_to_scorecard_and_action_led.not_applicable_reason: Read-only quality audit output is a release report, not a runtime producer event; applied fixes remain in ActionLedger.

cognitive_readiness_to_scorecard_and_act.not_applicable_reason: Read-only readiness aggregation consumes the underlying business flow receipts and must not write self-observation evidence.

flows.data_type: raw capture quality and completeness
flows.adaptive_effect: Incomplete or truncated raw data can defer distillation or require complete raw before writing knowledge.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Known-derived sources are reported separately; incomplete raw becomes audit/defer instead of silent write.

flows.data_type: distillation quality and structured output

writes: canonical cognition_episode revision and projection outbox

flows.adaptive_effect: Low value, conflict, duplicate, or invalid output changes write behavior to skip/defer/dispute/update/reinforce.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Invalid structured output is corrected once or blocked; non-create write plans do not create accidental pages.

flows.data_type: search and tool outcome scoring samples
flows.adaptive_effect: Search result counts, clicks, and outcomes train kg/profile dimensions and future scoring weights.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Scorer can report status and rollback model versions; failed enqueue logs warning without blocking search.

flows.data_type: wiki heat and access metrics
flows.adaptive_effect: Heat participates in search result explanation and can let quality gate wait for more evidence before distilling.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Missing metrics ledger degrades to cold/default heat and does not block search.

flows.data_type: freshness and version-bound knowledge state
flows.adaptive_effect: Stale pages are surfaced in search explanations and can be refreshed manually or in batch.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Refresh failure leaves existing page intact and reports stale/error state.

flows.data_type: entropy, duplicate, and disorder signals
flows.adaptive_effect: Entropy findings can generate reports or, with explicit auto-fix flags, add KG links.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Auto-fix requires explicit flag; scan-only mode does not mutate KG.

flows.data_type: canonical current Raw revision-backed objective observations plus committed replayable calibration records

writes: observations.db verified or historical_unverified base measurement plus committed calibration revision/input/spec/record hashes

reads: committed CalibrationRecord prior/posterior, independent support/counter clusters, source spans and omission receipts

flows.adaptive_effect: Canonical current Raw revisions feed exact Observation evidence; independent lineage clusters produce a committed replayable calibration posterior before Wiki projection, reflection, persona signals, PolicyPatchStore/no_patch evidence and later cognitive graph reconciliation.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Observation extraction can run incrementally with per-source durable cursors. Missing or malformed canonical Raw blocks instead of falling back to Markdown; every eligible Raw reaches an exact observation edge or a typed intentional_no_observation terminal, while extractor/persist failure stays retryable. Missing canonical CalibrationRecord leaves a verified base confidence unchanged; stale spec, partial pointer, calibrated historical_unverified base, derived double count or projection receipt gap fails the calibration audit. Legacy binding schema requires daemon-stopped, backup-first explicit reconciliation, marks an unrecoverable prior historical_unverified, and never fabricates a base or record. An all-visible-Raw skip state is a readiness failure, not green coverage.

flows.data_type: persona and behavior signals
flows.adaptive_effect: Persona influences behavior prompts, context search persona score, and preflight framing.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Missing profile degrades to neutral persona score and default behavior prompt.

flows.data_type: canonical subject-bound reaction attribution
flows.adaptive_effect: A reaction is recorded once against an exact subject. It may create reviewable target proposals, but it never directly changes trust, scores, persona, reflection, or push penalties.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Unknown action, missing or unauthorized subject, stale supersedes references, and incomplete correction compensation fail closed. Historical ambiguous rows remain quarantined and never become active cognition.

flows.data_type: retired direct predictive-push penalty path
flows.adaptive_effect: No direct penalty or reinforcement occurs. A predictive-push reaction can only create a reviewable proposal with exact provenance.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Missing or unauthorized delivery identity fails closed; legacy penalty state is historical input only and is quarantined during object-level migration.

flows.data_type: recap and dialog reminder state
flows.adaptive_effect: Urgent or due reminders become concise nudges; resolved/dismissed/expired reminders stop repeating; finalized or skipped recaps affect retrieval, policy, follow-up, persona, scheduler and scoring only through required receipts; negative feedback cancels, suppresses or compensates those effects; high/critical recap backlog is explicit health debt until resolved or dismissed.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Resolved/ignored/dismissed/expired reminders are filtered; no pending items returns quiet success; missing/failed target or correction receipts remain visible and retryable, stale leases are reclaimed idempotently, and superseded recap retrieval fails closed when correction state is unavailable; high/critical recap pending or reminder active over budget degrades health queues.
validation_commands: python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_reminder_engine.py tests/unit/test_dialog_reminder.py tests/unit/test_cli_reminder.py tests/unit/test_cli_recap.py tests/unit/test_retrospective_workflow.py -q

flows.data_type: KG confidence and relation evidence
flows.adaptive_effect: Confidence and source metadata affect relation projection, pruning candidates, and relation embedding context.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Weak or orphan relations are inspectable before pruning; relation embedding failures degrade to page/keyword search.

flows.data_type: adaptive configuration, rule weights, and runtime policy coverage
flows.adaptive_effect: EWMA/cooldown/shadow/rollback suggestions can tune distill, quality gate, raw, document, intent, delivery, trust, search and scoring parameters through audited EffectivePolicy consumers instead of a single push-count knob.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Consumers use active shadow overrides only when present, otherwise caller config/defaults remain authoritative; status and health expose active_shadow, metric_before, age and overdue rollback windows.

flows.data_type: module toggle state, activation evidence, and cold-start output contract
flows.adaptive_effect: Default-off modules can become eligible only after capability, privacy, cost, consumer readiness, and rollback evidence exist; unwired or stale toggles stay disabled.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Activation is recorded as a decision before runtime policy changes; no-consumer modules are registered_but_unwired and cannot auto-enable.

flows.data_type: module output, downstream consumer effect, and scorecard value proof
flows.adaptive_effect: A module being enabled is not enough; its output must be consumed by named consumers and prove a measurable behavior or value change.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Mutually exclusive raw-vault watchers declare raw_projection mutex; high-cost modules carry budget gates and disable/restore rollback strategy.

flows.data_type: migration plan, backup reference, verification, and rollback status
flows.adaptive_effect: Upgrade actions become explainable and recoverable instead of hidden in standalone scripts or Config alias reads.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Config stale-key apply creates a local backup and can rollback; wrapped legacy scripts stay blocked unless explicitly executed with backup review.

flows.data_type: snapshot manifest, checksum entries, restore preconditions, and conflict plan
flows.adaptive_effect: High-risk automation can point to a verifiable system snapshot before changing config, SQLite, vaults, ledgers, or module state.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Restore without a snapshot returns blocked; changed destination files are conflicts until explicitly allowed.

flows.data_type: data inventory, export manifest, freeze request, delete request, and deletion proof
flows.adaptive_effect: Users can inspect, export, freeze, and plan deletion across raw and derived data without leaking secrets in manifests or proofs.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Delete apply is blocked until freeze, snapshot ref, and confirmation exist; dry-run reports derived impacts first.

flows.data_type: golden fixture sample results, consumer proof, and benchmark scorecard
flows.adaptive_effect: Prompt, schema, router, scorer, quality gate, search, preflight, and persona changes can be compared against fixed synthetic cognition cases before they touch user data.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Strict mode fails when required fixtures, baseline, mock providers, consumers, or score thresholds are missing; trend_comparison reports score regressions.

flows.data_type: resource budget and runtime pressure
flows.adaptive_effect: Scheduler and status reporting can reduce or explain background work under constrained resources.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Resource probe failure reports unknown/default budget rather than stopping foreground commands.

flows.data_type: install lifecycle state, migration plan, backup reference, and repair actions
flows.adaptive_effect: Deployment/migration score can reflect first-run friction, blocked upgrade wrappers, backup availability, and whether repair-all gives structured next actions instead of free-text errors.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Upgrade apply records rollback_available with a snapshot ref when wrapped migrations are blocked; purge uninstall degrades to a data ownership delete dry-run until freeze/snapshot/confirm exist.

flows.data_type: wiki lint issue counts, lifecycle state mapping, budget lines, manual review queues, and auto-fix evidence
flows.adaptive_effect: Obsidian experience score and release readiness can distinguish rebuilt clean vaults from old-data debt, while auto metadata repair becomes auditable instead of silent filesystem mutation.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Broken links, orphan pages and stubs produce owner-tagged manual review queues; metadata repair is explicit --fix only and records wiki_quality_fix in ActionLedger.

flows.data_type: source refs coverage, canonical current Raw revision Observation terminals, Wiki page_role source-required/source-exempt accounting, evidence refs, delivery/outcome ledgers, search behavior outcomes, learning signal conversion, and reminder closure state

writes: ActionLedger cognitive_readiness_gap only when --record-gaps is explicit
cognitive_consolidation dry-run run rows when --record-run is explicit

flows.adaptive_effect: Cognitive assets score can distinguish generated/system/support pages from source-backed, evidence-backed, consumed, behavior-confirmed and learning-converted knowledge.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: Default audit remains read-only; budget mode fails nonzero on source-required knowledge page gaps, behavior outcome gaps, lineage gaps or an all-visible-Raw skip state. Source-exempt page roles and stale metric rows stay observable, health exposes non-strict cognitive_learning warnings, ActionLedger writes require explicit --record-gaps, and consolidation dry-run ledger writes require explicit --record-run.

flows.data_type: daemon raw_projection service error, heartbeat state, and recovery ledger record
flows.adaptive_effect: Operational health can distinguish current lock failures from already recovered raw_projection history without hiding the historical evidence.
flows.rollback_or_degradation: If a later run fails, raw_projection remains in active_service_errors; if a later run succeeds/skips, stale error state is cleared and recovery is audited.
